_comment: Inelastic nucleon-nucleon cross section in mb vs sqrt(s_NN) in GeV. Presets from PHENIX PRC 93 (2016) 024901 arXiv:1509.06727 Tab. IV (7.7-200 GeV) and LKD18/LKD25 (LHC). Fit: sigma = a + b ln^n(s), s in GeV^2, d'Enterria & Loizides Ann. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 71 (2021) 315 arXiv:2011.14909.
